items.q: Fill up: The complications of CKD are captured by the mnemonic A, B, C, D and ______, with a separate U-line for uremic symptoms.
items.exp: COMPLICATIONS: mnemonic ABCDE (A anemia/acidosis/access, B BP/bone, C cardiac, D dry weight, E electrolyte) plus U uremic symptoms. (Book p806)

items.q: Match the following complication letter to its content — 1) A  2) B  3) C  4) D … A) Dry weight  B) BP and bone mineral disease (renal osteodystrophy)  C) Cardiac — m/c cause of death  D) Anemia, acidosis and access for dialysis
items.exp: ABCDE: A — anemia (unfit for transplant; ↓ GFR independently), metabolic acidosis (↓ cardiac function), access for dialysis; B — BP, bone mineral disease (renal osteodystrophy); C — cardiac (m/c cause of death); D — dry weight. (Book p806)

items.q: Under A of the complications mnemonic, anemia is highlighted because it makes the patient:
items.exp: A — anemia: unfit for transplant; ↓ GFR independently. (Book p806)

items.q: In the same A-line, metabolic acidosis acts by:
All but one sit under A of the ABCDE mnemonic. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: A covers anemia, metabolic acidosis and access for dialysis; bone mineral disease is under B. (Book p806)

items.q: The cardiac (C) complication chain runs: left ventricular hypertrophy → ______.
opts: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
items.exp: C — cardiac (m/c cause of death): LVH → heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. (Book p806)

items.q: In the C-line, calcification is listed as a reason the patient becomes unfit for transplant.
opts: False — only anemia causes transplant unfitness
True, but only with GFR below 15
items.exp: C — cardiac: LVH → HFpEF; calcification → unfit for transplant. (Book p806)

items.q: Fill up: The E-line of the mnemonic covers the electrolytes Ca²⁺, PO₄³⁻ and ______.
The D-line of the complications mnemonic stands for:
A CKD patient is admitted with dyspnea; the echocardiogram shows LVH with a preserved ejection fraction. Under which letter of the complications mnemonic is this recorded?
items.exp: C — cardiac (m/c cause of death): LVH → heart failure with preserved ejection fraction. (Book p806)
